_comentario: Planos independientes: ninguno depende de otro, así que todos paralelizan y cualquiera se rehace solo. Se montan con cortes. Cada plano lleva 'usa' con el tramo que va a la línea: se genera de más porque H3 no baja de 5,17 s.

planos.funcion: HOOK. Mostrar de entrada, en primer plano, la bicicleta imposible trabada en la reja de la represa, con la profundidad y lo inquietante del entorno ya visibles, alineado con el texto y la voz que adelantan el hallazgo.
planos.prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic underwater footage.
MOTION: From the first frame the camera pushes in slowly toward the bicycle, while drifting slightly sideways, making the metal bars parallax against the dark water behind. Small debris and bubbles drift past the lens. The bike wobbles subtly in the current but remains stuck between the bars.
AUDIO: [SFX] Muffled low underwater rumble, faint metallic creaks from the grate, distant turbine hum. [Ambient] Constant deep underwater dam ambience with low-frequency vibrations. [Foley] Occasional light clinks of the bicycle frame subtly shifting against the metal bars.
NO SPEECH. No voices, no words, no dialogue, no singing, no crowd chatter. The only sounds are Low underwater rumble, distant turbine hum, muffled water currents, regulator breathing, subtle metal creaks, faint bubbles..
Keep the framing of the first frame. Grainy, cold, photographic. Not animated, not illustrated, not CGI-looking.
